record.name: Platform
record.purpose: The standards this group works to.

says: Alice founds a Team on her laptop, registers its knowledge source and commits a first revision; her desktop is enrolled as a second device. The laptop stages a complete transfer to the desktop by peer; the desktop's accept records received, then controls_verified naming the continuity record it put in force, then verified naming that controls record, then committed. The desktop undertakes custody of what arrived and acknowledges it, and returns that acknowledgment to the laptop in a return package, which the laptop verifies the same way (controls first, then bodies) and the Team accepts as a contribution with a receipt. The laptop then commits a second revision and stages an incremental transfer naming its baseline (the source head the desktop holds) and the acknowledgment it kept; the desktop verifies and commits it. Importing the same return package a second time answers with the duplicate outcome and the original receipt. What must not happen: verified recorded before controls_verified, a stage skipped, an incremental without the acknowledgment it rests on, or the second import accepting anything again.
